_comment: LIVE page inventory for every Figma file the catalog tracks, harvested directly
from Figma rather than from figma.txt. This exists because the catalog's node lists are
parsed from that hand-maintained link dump, so any page never pasted into it is
structurally invisible - the root cause of every coverage gap found on 2026-07-28.
build-registry.mjs reads this to stamp `page` and `readiness` on every frame and to
REPORT pages that no section covers, so the next missing page announces itself.
readiness comes from the leading emoji of the page NAME, which is the convention the
team actually uses (Casey, 2026-07-28). Figma's real Dev Mode devStatus flag is not
readable here: the MCP plugin sandbox rejects the getter and get_metadata omits it.
liveChildren = count of TOP-LEVEL children on the page, including furniture
(Directory / Breakpoint / Rectangle N / Vector N), so it is NOT directly comparable
to a section's frame count. null means not counted. Counting REQUIRES
setCurrentPageAsync per page: an unloaded page reports children.length === 0 rather
than throwing, so a bulk read silently reports an empty file. Every count below was
taken with an explicit page switch.

method: use_figma read-only: figma.root.children for the page list, then setCurrentPageAsync per page for children.length

★ theRenameIsTheStory: 99 of the 109 retitles are the 'Skai > Play 1VH' cluster the 08-18 pass
recorded as '~110 mobile/tablet Play frames drawn on the Social page'. Casey
has since renamed them in Figma to real Social breadcrumbs (Messages, Groups,
Discover, stories, create post, creator profile, post/token). The dead name
survived only in registry.json and snapshot.webapp-0818.json.
This matters beyond tidiness. figma-drift.mjs joins a REMOVED old id to an
ADDED new id by EXACT TITLE to recognise a rebuild (RETARGET). That join reads
the title from the REGISTRY on one side and from LIVE FIGMA on the other, so a
registry title that no longer equals the live name silently disables the
rescue for that frame — it would report as REMOVED and its implFiles would
look orphaned. Leaving a stale title in place is therefore not the safe
option; it is the failure mode. The rule that protects the join is 'the
registry title must equal the live Figma name', which is why titles are
re-harvested from <section>.titles.tsv on every build and are NOT in
build-registry's preserved-hand-set list. What must never happen is a
hand-authored 'more accurate' title that matches neither.
The 109 before/after pairs are preserved verbatim in
figma-drift.social-0821.json, so no prior name is lost by this update.

CORRECTION, same day, and it inverts an earlier entry above: V1 IS NOT SUPERSEDED. The tombstone pages in Skai-Web-App carry node ids 2003:674 / 2998:19593 / 3:3 - the SAME ids as Home 1 / Wallet 1 / Trade 1 in Skai-Web-App-2. Their text reads "moved to Skai Web App 2", which names the FILE. Home 1 IS the moved page. Home 2 / Wallet 2 / Trade 2 are page-continuation indices INSIDE that file, created because one page was split across two canvases for width - not replacements.

Evidence, measured: the Directory banners PARTITION the product rather than duplicate it (Home 1 = Home / with deposit / moat / Portfolio; Home 2 = Whales / Pro / Advanced Tools; Trade 1 = Spot / Perps / Trade Utilities; Trade 2 = Trench / Launch / Swap). And Home 1 holds the NEWEST content in the file: max node id prefix 13502 against Home 2 max 13459, with a Directory dated 25 Aug 2026. A superseded page does not receive newer frames than the page said to replace it.

Scale of the real supersession: 4 surfaces / 19 frames of 852 children (2.2%), not 826 frames. TRADE 2 CONTAINS NO SPOT, NO PERPS AND NO DASHBOARD - treating Trade 1 as superseded would have retired the core trading surfaces. 191 surfaces / 490 frames on the v1 pages have NO v2 counterpart and remain parity targets.

GAP FOUND while establishing this: the "Home - with deposit" cluster (8 surfaces, Directory dated 25 Aug 2026, ids 13484-13502) has ZERO rows in any status file - the string appears nowhere in the catalog. All 8 are 1440-only; no 768 or 375 tier exists.

Also corrected: the existing status files were never v1-only. status.home.tsv is 37 Home-1 + 14 Home-2 rows; status.wallet.tsv is 33 + 21; status.trade.tsv is 30 Trade-1 + 48 Trade-2. The denominator error ran in both directions.

CAUTION for whoever reads the entries above this one: the phrase "v2 supersedes v1" appears in several 2026-08-26 commit messages and in LANE_BRIEF_V2_2026-08-26.md. It came from the coordinator misreading the tombstones, and the ruling that followed was made on that false premise. The v2 pages genuinely had ZERO parity assessment and needed the wave - that part stands. What does NOT stand is any conclusion that v1 frames stopped being parity targets.
